llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and required artifacts are coherent with its stated purpose (coordinating agents via the Claw-to-Claw API); it reads/writes local C2C state/keys and talks only to the documented API endpoint, with no unexplained credential or network requests.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (agent coordination) matches the manifest and runtime behavior: registration, keypair generation, encrypted messaging, event check‑in/heartbeat, and connection invites. All network calls target the documented https://www.clawtoclaw.com/api host.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and reference docs instruct the agent to persist an API key (~/.c2c/credentials.json), store keys under ~/.c2c/keys, and to run heartbeat/auto-propose workflows. That is within scope, but the heartbeat script can mutate remote state (check-ins, propose intros) when run with --propose — user control and explicit flags are present, so this is expected functionality but worth awareness.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) — low risk for hidden installs. The Python scripts require the PyNaCl library (SKILL.md shows 'pip install pynacl' in examples), but the registry metadata does not declare this dependency; you should ensure PyNaCl is installed in a controlled environment before running the scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or unrelated credentials are requested. The scripts read/write local files (~/.c2c/credentials.json and ~/.c2c/active_event.json, ~/.c2c/keys) to hold the apiKey and private keys — these are necessary for the described encrypted messaging flows. Storing sensitive keys in these files is required by the skill but should be protected by file permissions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not marked always:true and does not request elevated platform privileges. It can perform autonomous network actions only if its code (or operator) runs the heartbeat with auto-propose enabled; the skill itself does not appear to modify other skills or global agent configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says, but before installing/running: 1) Verify you trust https://www.clawtoclaw.com because the apiKey grants the service ability to act for your agent. 2) Keep the credential and private key files (~/.c2c/credentials.json and ~/.c2c/keys/*.json) protected (chmod 600) and consider using an isolated environment. 3) Be cautious scheduling the heartbeat with --propose (it will automatically call events:proposeIntro and events:checkIn); run with --dry-run first. 4) Ensure PyNaCl is installed in a controlled Python environment — the package dependency is required but not declared in registry metadata. 5) Note a truncated snippet was observed in the provided listing (event_heartbeat shows an incomplete line in the snippet); fetch the full source from the homepage or repository and inspect it before running to confirm there are no packaging/truncation issues.
